/science/2026/sep/28/spacex-starship-roc.headline: SpaceX Starship reaches orbit for the first time
/science/2026/sep/28/spacex-starship-roc.trail: The mission succeeded despite concerns that an initial engine failure after the Texas launch would scupper the attempt.
/science/2026/sep/28/spacex-starship-roc.progress: SpaceX overcame an initial engine failure after launch to put its Starship rocket into orbit for the first time.

/science/2026/sep/28/gene-edited-non-bro.headline: Gene-edited bananas that resist browning could reduce UK food waste
/science/2026/sep/28/gene-edited-non-bro.trail: The scientific breakthrough could reduce food waste and make it easier to add the fruit to prepackaged food, and the bananas could reach UK supermarkets.
/science/2026/sep/28/gene-edited-non-bro.progress: Scientists have developed gene-edited, non-browning bananas that could reduce food waste and ease use in prepackaged food.

/environment/2026/sep/30/australia-elect.headline: Australian electric car sales more than double to record high
/environment/2026/sep/30/australia-elect.trail: A record 157,957 new EVs were sold nationally between January and June, according to the Electric Vehicle Council – equivalent to one every 100 seconds.
/environment/2026/sep/30/australia-elect.progress: The Electric Vehicle Council reports a record 157,957 new EVs sold across Australia in the first half of the year.

/environment/2026/sep/28/heat-pump-sales.headline: Electricity tax reductions drive heat pump sales higher across Europe, data shows
/environment/2026/sep/28/heat-pump-sales.trail: The EU plans to push member states to cut electricity tax rates below those on gas duty, after an 11% rise in heat pump sales, partly linked to fallout from the Iran war.
/environment/2026/sep/28/heat-pump-sales.progress: The EU plans to push member states to cut electricity tax rates below duty on gas.

/environment/2026/sep/29/cambodia-chorng.headline: Cambodia acts to save one of the world's last wild Siamese crocodile populations
/environment/2026/sep/29/cambodia-chorng.trail: Indigenous communities play a crucial role in the effort, as a 'genetic bank' area of wetland offers hope for the critically endangered reptile.
/environment/2026/sep/29/cambodia-chorng.progress: Indigenous communities are playing a crucial role in protecting one of the world's last wild Siamese crocodile populations.

/environment/2026/sep/28/river-avon-char.headline: New charter grants Bristol's River Avon rights as a 'contract between humans and river'
/environment/2026/sep/28/river-avon-char.trail: The river charter is part of a wider movement establishing a 'moral' framework to protect nature and hold institutions to account.

/lifeandstyle/2026/sep/28/kindness-of-st.headline: Two helicopter pilots make a three-year-old's day with a low flypast
/lifeandstyle/2026/sep/28/kindness-of-st.trail: The boy and his parent waved as hard as they could when a helicopter flew past, then it looped back for a second pass, delighting the toddler, who adores helicopters.
